clean: Visited Dad at the hospital today, he is doing better. The doctors said he can probably go home on Friday if his numbers stay good. He was sitting up in bed doing the crossword and complaining about the food, which is a good sign. The nurses are lovely, one of them named Grace even brought him an extra pudding. I stayed for three hours and we mostly talked about foot. I drove home feeling lighter than I have in a week. Tomorrow I will bring the glasses and the pillow, and maybe a better crossword book, the one he has is too easy for him.
